protocol.title: Single-asset options term-structure term_slope -> forward realized return variance of the signed return predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (surface signal/floor via build_surface_bars, 900s window) + EVAL-74 (term_slope via _term_bars) + EVAL-101 (single-asset surface signal path verbatim) + EVAL-159 (forward realized return variance target verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed / zwindow); distinct cell: single-asset term_slope -> forward realized return variance of signed return
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-172/173 (atm_iv/skew -> forward variance) with a term-structure-shape signal; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM options term-structure term_slope = IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry) (vol points) from the real Deribit option trade tape over the trailing 900s window, forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e74._term_bars, e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return variance = mean((r - mean(r))**2) of the next H perp log returns, strictly after the decision at bar k; transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-159
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_slope_z_k, var_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (steeper near-minus-far IV slope -> higher forward realized variance)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
